brand_identity.mission: Empower restaurant owners with clear, actionable financial insights without the accounting jargon.
brand_identity.tone: Professional, Efficient, Trustworthy, Crisp, yet Warm (Hospitality)
brand_identity.design_philosophy: Kitchen Precision. Everything has a place. Clean lines, high contrast for readability in busy environments, with a touch of warmth.

usage_rules.headings: Use Manrope. Tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.03em). Don't just use Bold; use Semibold or ExtraBold for contrast.
usage_rules.body: Use IBM Plex Sans. Excellent legibility for numbers and data tables.

primary.description: Deep Navy / Obsidian - The Anchor. Used for Sidebar and Primary Actions.

secondary.description: Slate 100 - Used for secondary buttons and subtle backgrounds.

accent.description: Sophisticated Teal - Used for Brand highlights, active states, and success metrics. NOT generic bright teal.

sidebar.behavior: Fixed left, h-screen. Collapsible on mobile.

buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 shadow-sm font-medium

cards.base: bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md

inputs.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500/20 focus:border-teal-500 transition-all rounded-md h-10 px-3

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent sizing (w-5 h-5).

charts.style: Minimalist. Remove grid lines where possible. Rounded corners on bars.

design_principles: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids and asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp rounded-md).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
component_reuse: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components.
Examine existing components to understand patterns.
export_conventions: Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the specified colors (Primary #0f172a, Accent #0d9488).
Implement the Sidebar layout with the dark theme (#020617).
Build the Dashboard using the 'Bento Grid' layout.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Use 'Manrope' font for all headings (h1-h6) and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
Create the 'Upload Center' with a distinct drag-and-drop zone using dashed borders and accent color on hover.
Ensure Charts use the specified color palette.
